head: Collagen synthesis and fibril assembly regulation
name: Collagen synthesis and fibril assembly regulation
rationale: Members are positive and negative control of collagen synthesis and fibril/matrix assembly; confusables instead add crosslinking, elastic fibres or collagen degradation.

head: Xenobiotic and steroid metabolism
name: Xenobiotic and steroid metabolism (cytochromes, sulfonation, flavones and glycosides)
rationale: Cytochrome and sulfotransferase biotransformation of xenobiotics and steroids; flavone metabolism and glycoside transport separate it from toxin/alkaloid/drug-ADME confusables.

head: Endocrine hormone axis regulation
name: Endocrine hormone axis regulation (thyroid hormone, HPA-glucocorticoid, leptin and growth)
rationale: Secretion and action of thyroid and adrenal glucocorticoid hormones plus leptin/growth signalling; thyroid content separates it from HPA-stress confusables and leptin from the steroidogenesis confusable.

head: Kidney development
name: Kidney development (nephron tubule patterning, nephric duct, intermediate mesoderm)
rationale: Embryonic kidney formation from intermediate mesoderm through nephric duct to segmented nephron tubules; confusables centre on ureteric bud branching, kidney size and proliferation/apoptosis.

head: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in organogenesis
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in organogenesis (lung, prostate, salivary and lacrimal glands)
rationale: Reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling shaping lung, trachea, prostate and exocrine glands; confusables are mammary, pancreatic and gonadal development.

head: FOXO transcription factor regulation
name: FOXO transcription factor regulation (AKT phosphorylation, acetylation, nuclear localization)
rationale: All members describe control of FOXO activity, chiefly by AKT; confusables are p53/mTORC1, NRF2 and metabolic transcription programmes.

head: Pituitary-testis gonadotropin axis
name: Pituitary-testis gonadotropin axis (FSH and LH secretion, Sertoli cell proliferation, seminiferous tubules)
rationale: Gonadotropin release and FSH action on Sertoli cells in seminiferous tubule development; confusables cover gonadotropin inhibition, activin or germ/Leydig cells.

head: Microtubule-based organelle transport
name: Microtubule-based organelle transport (mitochondria, synaptic vesicles, endolysosome size)
rationale: Microtubule-driven positioning of mitochondria and vesicles plus endosome/lysosome size control; confusables are autophagy-lysosome fusion or kinesin neuronal cargo without size control.

head: Type II sodium-phosphate cotransport
name: Type II sodium-phosphate cotransport (phosphate homeostasis, hypophosphatemic rickets, alveolar microlithiasis)
rationale: Type II Na+/Pi cotransporters, their regulation and hereditary defects; confusables are bicarbonate/anion exchangers and mineralization transporters.

head: Nephric duct and ureter morphogenesis
name: Nephric duct and ureter morphogenesis (epithelial tube formation, mesonephros)
rationale: Formation of the nephric duct and ureter epithelial tubes; confusables centre on ureteric bud budding, nephron development or kidney size.

head: Immunosuppressive cytokine signaling
name: Immunosuppressive cytokine signaling (IL-10, IL-27, IL-35)
rationale: IL-10-family regulatory cytokine signalling and control of IL-10/IL-12 production; confusables are IL-12/23/17 and fungal C-type lectin responses.

head: Myeloid lineage differentiation
name: Myeloid lineage differentiation (RUNX transcriptional control, granulocytes, megakaryocytes and erythrocytes)
rationale: Commitment and maturation of granulocyte, erythroid and megakaryocyte lineages under RUNX control; confusables are HSC maintenance/erythropoiesis or non-haematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

head: Caspase-8-controlled cell death
name: Caspase-8-controlled cell death (death receptor apoptosis, RIPK1 necroptosis, TLR3-TRIF)
rationale: Death-receptor and TRIF signals converging on caspase-8 to give apoptosis or RIPK1 necroptosis; confusables are mitochondrial, execution-phase or T-cell apoptosis.

head: Regulation of stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
name: Regulation of stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis (hydrogen peroxide, hypoxia)
rationale: Positive and negative control of intrinsic apoptosis triggered by H2O2 and hypoxia; confusables are general oxidative stress responses, respiration or MOMP control.

head: Innate behaviour
name: Innate behaviour (mating and reproduction, social interaction, exploratory locomotion)
rationale: Innate behaviours spanning mating, social and exploratory locomotor acts; confusables lack the reproductive or locomotor parts and add sensory, drinking or learned behaviours.

head: Cardiac impulse conduction
name: Cardiac impulse conduction (phase 0 depolarization, gap-junction coupling, His-Purkinje)
rationale: Propagation of the cardiac action potential by fast depolarization and electrical coupling; confusables are SA-node pacemaking, repolarization or conduction-system development.

head: Postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking
name: Postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking (AMPA receptors, endosomal recycling, postsynaptic actin)
rationale: Endosomal internalization and recycling of postsynaptic receptors; confusables are presynaptic organization, BDNF signalling or AMPA clustering and plasticity.

head: Leak potassium control of nociception
name: Leak potassium control of nociception (K2P channels, resting potential, thermal and mechanical pain)
rationale: K2P leak channels setting resting potential in pain and temperature detection; confusables are TRP/tachykinin, Ca2+-activated K+ channels or itch and fever.

head: Coagulation and fibrinolysis
name: Coagulation and fibrinolysis (factor XII contact activation, plasma kallikrein, plasminogen activation)
rationale: Clot formation and dissolution with FXII-kallikrein contact activation; confusables are factor VIII/IX/V defects or von Willebrand factor variants.

head: Mitochondrial tRNA maturation
name: Mitochondrial tRNA maturation (3'-end processing, modification)
rationale: Processing and modification of mitochondrial tRNAs; confusables are aminoacylation, pseudouridylation, ribosome assembly or mRNA stability.

head: Endocardial cushion development
name: Endocardial cushion development (EMT, heart valves, cardiac septa)
rationale: Endocardial cushion EMT forming valves and septa; confusables are myocardial, heart-tube or ventricular morphogenesis.

head: Organelle positioning and ER network shaping
name: Organelle positioning and ER network shaping (kinesin transport, Miro GTPases, contact-site tethering)
rationale: Placement and shape of organelles by kinesin transport, Miro GTPases, ER tubule shaping and membrane tethering; contact-site tethering and ER shaping separate it from the transport and lipid-transfer confusables.

head: Nucleocytoplasmic transport and GTPase regulation
name: Nucleocytoplasmic transport and GTPase regulation (nuclear import, nuclear export, growth and cell-fate gene modules)
rationale: Most members regulate nuclear import/export and GTPase activity, but two gene modules on mTOR growth control and neuronal cell fate do not share that idea; confusables are nuclear pore, PML/senescence and viral host targeting.

head: Downstream antigen receptor signaling
name: Downstream antigen receptor signaling (second messengers, PKC, NF-κB and IL-2)
rationale: Signalling distal to TCR/BCR through second messengers and PKC to NF-κB and IL-2; confusables are proximal CD3/ZAP-70, CD28 costimulation or non-canonical NF-κB.

head: RNA polymerase II initiation-to-elongation transition
name: RNA polymerase II initiation-to-elongation transition (preinitiation complex assembly, promoter clearance, elongation activation)
rationale: Positive control of Pol II from preinitiation complex through promoter escape and pausing into elongation; confusables are negative elongation control and HIV transcription.
